title: Serialized environment promotions in a CI system
name: Environment promotion coordinator

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code acquires and releases the per-environment lock? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Two pipelines call promote("staging", ...) with different digests at nearly the same time. What happens?
choices: Both apply concurrently because each gets its own EnvironmentLock
The second throws immediately because the lock is held
The second waits until the first releases, then checks currentDigest() and deploys
The second is skipped because currentDigest() was read before the first finished

questions.prompt: Why does EnvironmentLock.acquire() re-check `this.held` in a while loop after being woken instead of just taking the lock?
choices: Because release() wakes every waiter at once
Because another caller can call acquire() and take the lock between the wake-up and the woken waiter resuming
Because Promises can resolve more than once
It is unnecessary; an if statement would behave identically in every case

questions.prompt: A pipeline re-promotes a digest that is already live in production. What does promote() do?
choices: Re-applies it and runs the health check again
Returns skipped: true without ever touching the lock
Returns skipped: true without calling apply(), after acquiring and releasing the lock
